disclaimer: Engineering diligence from license texts fetched 2026-10-17. NOT legal advice. verification=primary_fetched means the license text/page was read; secondary_search_snippet means only a search summary was seen; unverified means not confirmed. Fields marked 'unverified' inside text must not be relied on.

recommended_tag_classes.note: needs_counsel was adopted into data/provenance.py LICENSE_CLASSES on 2026-10-17 (MultiSenseGolf retag), so it is listed under existing.

cc_by.note: CC BY 4.0 data (e.g. 100STYLE). Store credit string in acknowledgment_text.

commercial_license_required.note: Commercial route exists only via a paid/negotiated license or entity-eligibility test (AMASS, SMPL, Human3.6M, BONES-SEED).

needs_counsel.note: License ambiguous or conflicting (GolfPose, Mixamo ML clause, AIST++ derived annotations, KIT). Default to commercial_ok False until counsel clears.

proposed_tag_mapping.also_propose: boolean tag counsel_required and string tag license_url in the npz provenance keys; keep default-deny for anything unrecognized.

datasets.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
datasets.domain: optical mocap, general (2605 trials, 6 categories; subject 64 = golf)
datasets.license_name: Custom statement ('free for all uses')
datasets.license_evidence_quote: This dataset of motions is free for all uses. ... You may include this data in commercially-sold products, but you may not resell this data directly, even in converted form. ... add this text to your acknowledgments: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
datasets.commercial_note: Commercial products OK; no standalone resale of data even converted. NOTE: the FAQ page (http://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/faqs.php) separately says 'may be copied, modified, or redistributed without permission' - the two statements are not identical; follow the stricter home-page text.
datasets.attribution_requirement: Acknowledgment text requested in publications (we require it in the project).
datasets.counsel_reason: Retagged 2026-10: CMU forbids resale 'even in converted form' and its home page and FAQ wording differ; whether public redistribution of converted .npz in this repo and commercial model training fall within that clause is unresolved.

datasets.name: AMASS (Archive of Mocap as Surface Shapes)
datasets.domain: SMPL-fitted aggregation of ~15+ mocap datasets (general)
datasets.golf_relevance: medium (contains some golf/sports; includes CMU re-fit)
datasets.license_name: MPI Dataset Copyright License for non-commercial scientific research
datasets.license_evidence_quote: This license also prohibits the use of the Dataset to train methods/algorithms/neural networks/etc. for commercial use of any kind. ... For commercial uses of the Dataset, please send email to [contact email listed on the dataset page]
datasets.commercial_note: Non-commercial research/education/artistic only; explicit ban on training models for commercial use; no sharing with third parties; no redistribution. Applies even to the CMU subset as distributed by AMASS (the AMASS wrapper terms govern what you get from AMASS; use CMU's own original files for CMU-permissive use).
datasets.attribution_requirement: Cite Mahmood et al. ICCV 2019 in publications.
datasets.ml_training_note: Explicit prohibition: no training for commercial use.
datasets.size: unverified (commonly cited ~40 h; not on the fetched license page)
datasets.format: SMPL-H npz (requires SMPL+H/DMPL body models, themselves non-commercial)
datasets.counsel_reason: Commercial license route: [contact email listed on the dataset page]

datasets.name: SMPL body model (and SMPL-X/SMPL+H family)
datasets.domain: parametric body model used by AMASS, AIST++, 3DPW, BEDLAM, HumanML3D, WHAM/GVHMR
datasets.golf_relevance: medium (needed to read most SMPL-format mocap; WHAM/GVHMR pose pipeline depends on it)
datasets.license_name: SMPL-Model License (academic research)
datasets.license_evidence_quote: This software/data and the associated license is for academic research purposes. The software/data is also available for commercial licensing through Meshcapade.com. ... This license also prohibits the use of the Software to train methods/algorithms/neural networks/etc. for commercial use of any kind.
datasets.commercial_note: Commercial use requires a license (Meshcapade; [contact email listed on the dataset page]). Using SMPL as an intermediate in a commercial pipeline (e.g. WHAM/GVHMR video->SMPL->humanoid) is likely covered by the 'commercial use / production of artefacts for commercial purposes' language. SMPL-X page not fetched directly (search snippet only: also commercially licensed via Meshcapade).
datasets.attribution_requirement: Cite Loper et al. SIGGRAPH Asia 2015.
datasets.ml_training_note: Explicit prohibition on training for commercial use (the model itself).
datasets.counsel_reason: Whether outputs of a pipeline that merely passes through SMPL (e.g. our own self-filmed video -> WHAM -> joint angles -> humanoid) are 'artefacts for commercial purposes' under this license is a legal question. Prefer a non-SMPL pose path (MediaPipe, which the project already uses) for commercial data.

datasets.name: MultiSenseGolf
datasets.domain: golf: IMU full-body kinematics, foot pressure, FPV/RGB-D video, gaze, launch monitor
datasets.license_name: CC0 1.0 (Dataverse default waiver; per record)
datasets.license_evidence_quote: Dataverse datasets are CC0 by default unless the depositor opts out (dataverse.org community norms). Record: 'MultiSenseGolf ... 1,557 swing records from 24 participants'.
datasets.commercial_note: CC0 waiver on the record permits any use, but data are about identifiable people (video, gaze, body measurements); consent scope and GDPR/Korea-privacy implications for commercial model training are not something the CC0 label settles. Project uses joint-position data only (no video).
datasets.attribution_requirement: None required (CC0); citation courtesy.
datasets.size: 1,557 swings, 24 participants (record abstract); full-body IMU joint kinematics; project converted 28 swings from P19/P20/P22 (P10, P14 available, 1-2 GB each)
datasets.counsel_reason: CC0 + identifiable participants + consent scope. Existing project tag 'multisensegolf_cc0' sets commercial_ok=True; recommend keeping it but gate commercial release on counsel sign-off (already a pending item).
